statements.quote: We are confident as a management team that we will be able to deliver on the guided level of 20% plus annual growth over the next 5 years.
statements.target: Achieve ~20% CAGR in AUM from now to FY30, targeting Rs 55,000 crore AUM by FY30.

statements.quote: We now anticipate full-year AUM growth of around 18%.
statements.target: Target full-year AUM growth of 18% for FY26.

statements.quote: We have actually guided that we are committed to bringing the OPEX to asset ratio below 3% over the medium term.
statements.target: Reduce OPEX-to-asset ratio to below 3% over the medium term.

statements.quote: Our Net profit for Q2 FY26 grew by 11% YoY to Rs 1.64 bn led by robust 18% YoY growth in NII.
statements.target: Achieve 18% YoY growth in Net Interest Income and 11% YoY growth in net profit for Q2 FY26.

statements.quote: Our Net Total Income (NIM) in absolute terms grew by 18% YoY in Q2 FY26.
statements.target: Grow NIM by 18% YoY in FY26.

statements.quote: See, over the last 5 months, our monthly disbursement run rate has remained above Rs. 500 crores and with H2 being seasonally strong for us, we are working towards taking this run rate to Rs. 700 crores plus kind of a range.
statements.target: Raise monthly disbursement run rate to over Rs. 700 crore.

statements.quote: Plus, from a digital sourcing perspective, we have diversified our mix by having digital channels like CSC, Mitra, and others, and that volume also we start seeing a steady increase on month-on- month and quarter-on- quarter basis.
statements.target: Expand digital sourcing mix (CSC, Mitra, etc.) to drive volume growth.

statements.quote: We remain well-capitalized, with a net worth of Rs 46.8 billion and a Capital Risk-Weighted Assets Ratio (CRAR) of 46.4%, significantly above regulatory requirements.
statements.target: Maintain net worth of Rs 46.8bn and CRAR of 46.4% in FY26.
